notes: Parent Lennox per page header. Sister/similar brands listed on the page (AirEase, Airease-Johnson, Aire-flo, Armstrong Air, Concord, Ducane, Lennox, Magic-Pak) are not stated to share these serial styles, so no sisters are claimed and no usesStylesOf is set; the page's style images are Airease-named files but only the page's text positions are encoded, never image contents. Page style 2 is held for the image pass (year/month letters chart-only). Day positions in style 3 are recorded in that style's notes but day is not encodable in the locked schema (no day field).

styles.notes: Page example shown as '1606 B13871' (space stripped by normalization). Year = 3rd & 4th positions (digits). Month = 5th position letter per legend images Style-1_Airease-Date-of-Manufacture_Serial-Number-Nomenclature.png and its data-plate image, held for the image pass, so year-only.

Page example shown as '15 A67 JA098'. Day = 1st & 2nd positions (15) is documented on the page but not encoded (locked schema has no day field). Week = 3rd position letter per chart image Style-3_Airease-Date-of-Manufacture_Serial-Number-Nomenclature1.png, held for the image pass, so year-only. Year = 4th & 5th positions (digits), 0-based [3,5]. Style id keeps the page's style-3 numbering.

styles.era: Numeric, year at positions 7-8 + week at 9-10 (page style 4)
styles.notes: Page example shown as '41407203 28' (space stripped by normalization). Year = 7th & 8th positions, week = 9th & 10th positions (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open ranges. Style id keeps the page's style-4 numbering.
